findings.title: SSRF Dynamic Outbound Request
findings.description: Source-to-sink indicator: request. reaches requests.get( near the same function/block.
findings.business_impact: Internal service access, metadata exposure (AWS IMDS), SSRF pivot to RCE, lateral movement.
remediation: Allow outbound requests only to an explicit server-side destination allow-list; never trust a client-supplied URL by itself.
Resolve the destination and validate every resulting IP address, including IPv4, IPv6, loopback, link-local, private, and cloud-metadata ranges.
Re-validate the destination after DNS resolution and after redirects; prevent DNS-rebinding and redirect-based allow-list bypasses.
Allow only required URL schemes, use a controlled egress proxy where possible, and block direct access to internal management and metadata endpoints.
Add regression tests for private IPs, IPv6, encoded/alternate IP forms, redirects, DNS rebinding, and cloud metadata addresses.

rule_contract.title: SSRF Dynamic Outbound Request
rule_contract.description: Source-to-sink indicator: request. reaches requests.get( near the same function/block.

remediation: Validate all outbound URLs against a server-side allow-list of trusted hosts.
Block requests to private IP ranges (10.x, 172.16.x, 192.168.x, 169.254.x).
Use a dedicated HTTP proxy that enforces egress filtering.
Disable unnecessary URL schemes (file://, gopher://, dict://).
Never forward raw user-supplied URLs to backend HTTP clients.

findings.cve_note: Code-level vulnerability (no CVE). Mapped to CWE-918.

deduplicated_privacy_findings.business_impact: Sensitive data movement may expand breach impact and regulatory exposure.
recommended_actions: Review correlated sensitive data flows and confirm data classification for each source/sink.
Add masking/encryption at sinks and enforce data minimisation in API responses.
Map each sensitive flow to owner, purpose, retention, and approved processing basis.
false_positive_controls: data-flow context is telemetry only and does not establish privacy exposure
requires independent privacy source-to-sink evidence before EXPOSED classification
